summary.headline: Soosan Industries amends KRW 73.3bn nuclear plant maintenance supply contract with KHNP
summary.what_happened: Soosan Industries Co., Ltd. filed a corrected disclosure for a single supply contract for electrical and mechanical maintenance work on Shin-Kori Units 1 and 2, with Korea Hydro & Nuclear Power as the counterparty. The correction follows a change agreement that raised the contract amount from KRW 70.06bn to KRW 73.29bn, and the contract period runs from Aug 1, 2024 to Jul 31, 2027.
summary.why_it_matters: Single supply or construction contracts of this size are typically disclosed so shareholders can gauge the scale of a company's order backlog relative to its revenue. The filing notes that amounts and periods may change as the work progresses.
